title: IEC104: add dissection of CP24Time2a time tags
description:
This patch adds support for values with a three-octet time tag.

Related to #16428

notes.body: Yes, I kept the bit mask just because `hf_cp56time_ms` has one too. Should I remove it in both cases?
Yes, unless showing the bit setting improves the dissection...
